evidence: Matches the RPC/REST/ZMQ label and modifies RPC definition helpers in src/rpc/util.h along with multiple RPC implementation files.
rationale: Compile-time enforcement of RPC argument and result field naming rules improves interface consistency and prevents developer mistakes. The description notes that without snake_case enforcement 'there are bugs and confusion' (citing #35317), providing worthwhile automated enforcement for RPC definitions.
